verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Stripe Terminal has extensive markdown docs, an OpenAPI spec repo, and a CLI, but nothing describes an interactive API reference with runnable/executable code examples (e.g., a 'try it' console) — the openapi.json probe even returned 404 on the docs site. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or demo of an interactive reference UI, runnable code snippets, or a live sandbox tied to the API reference.
